title: What if you could rob a bank and never get caught
description: A three-minute fictional story with spoken dialogue only: Maya leads an adult class, Leo imagines actually taking a bank money bag, and Officer Max pursues him but cannot catch him. Everyone sees Leo; only capture is impossible. Preserve the premise: the theft occurs inside the imagined story. Do not conclude that he never took it, never did anything, or that all events were erased. Show classroom, outdoor field, bank lobby, a sustained street chase, a cafe sip, and Leo handing the bag to Maya voluntarily before returning to the classroom.
